name: start-career-proof-inventory
description: Builds a Career Proof Inventory from your CV and your memory, with one row per piece of past work, who saw it, what you may say in public and what stays confidential, and the three strongest proofs you choose. Use for "run start-career-proof-inventory", "turn my CV into proof", "what can I say about my old job", "I have no case studies yet", "my track record belongs to my old employer", "list my past work", "what proof do I have", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
